plan.archetype: Multi-hit attacks and shivs with dexterity-backed defense
plan.bossPrep: Strip nine Slippery stacks with repeated hits. Maintain Weak, prepare strong block for Dismember, and bring defensive potions and draw for Wounds.
plan.summary: Add efficient damage first, then shiv scaling, dexterity and draw. Remove Strikes once damage improves. Fight optional elites only with damage upgrades and potion support; preserve boss-entry health.

plan.archetype: Scaling poison with multihit attacks and dexterity-backed defense
plan.bossPrep: Strip nine Slippery stacks with repeated hits. Establish upgraded Fumes, maintain Weak, cover Dismember, and bring defensive potions with healthy boss-entry HP.
plan.summary: Upgrade poison scaling now; prioritize dexterity, efficient defense and draw over marginal attacks. Remove Strikes. Reassess health at later fires, healing before the elite or boss when needed.

plan.archetype: Scaling poison with efficient defense and multihit burst
plan.bossPrep: Establish Fumes early, accelerate damage with direct poison and Accelerant, cover heavy bites, and play escapes before sand expires. Bring defensive potions.
plan.summary: Use shops to acquire poison acceleration, dexterity and efficient block; remove Strikes. Avoid elites while defense remains weak. Upgrade Shadowmeld when healthy; otherwise heal. Preserve Skewer for burst and escape-payment flexibility.

plan.archetype: Poison and multihit burst behind efficient defense
plan.bossPrep: Recover health, bring defensive potions, establish poison early, use Shadowmeld against heavy bites, and pay for escapes before sand expires.
plan.summary: Seek immediate healing and refuse HP costs. Spend shop gold on healing or efficient defense before removals. Use potions proactively to survive hallways; retain Skewer for burst.
